# spoke Provider

Experimental Spoke provider for the provisional `mock-v5` management API. No live platform service is qualified. Credentials come from `SPOKE_TOKEN` or `token_file`. Organization-only configuration can bootstrap projects and environments; project/environment assertions narrow access for dependent services.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    spoke = {
      source = "spoke-sh/spoke"
      # No public release is available; acceptance uses an isolated test mirror.
    }
  }
}

# Experimental mock-v5 API. Supply SPOKE_TOKEN or an external token_file.
provider "spoke" {
  endpoint        = "https://management.example.invalid"
  organization_id = "org-example"
  # Omit project_id/environment_id to bootstrap scope and access resources.
  # Bucket resources require known project_id and environment_id assertions.
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint` (String) Explicit HTTPS management origin. No default production target.
- `organization_id` (String) Expected organization ID.

### Optional

- `ca_file` (String) Path to additional PEM CA certificates. TLS verification remains enabled.
- `environment_id` (String) Optional target assertion requiring project_id. Required for environment-scoped services; omit when managing parent scopes.
- `project_id` (String) Optional target assertion. Omit for organization-scoped bootstrap; a configured value must already be known.
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Total timeout per lifecycle operation, including polling; defaults to 60 seconds. Range: 1–3600.
- `token_file` (String) Path to an external machine credential. Takes precedence over `SPOKE_TOKEN`; credential bytes are not schema attributes.
